pure-black.$description: Pure Black — Page canvas, hero backgrounds, full-bleed sections — the void that makes all imagery and accent color read as luminous

surface-one.$description: Surface One — Primary card surface, elevated panels, and section backgrounds one level above the canvas

surface-two.$description: Surface Two — Secondary button background (ghost/outlined), nested cards, and hover surfaces one step lighter than Surface One

surface-three.$description: Surface Three — Tertiary button background, highest elevation layer, and active-state surface tints

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Primary headings, button text, logo, and high-emphasis copy on dark surfaces

fog.$description: Fog — Hairline borders and dividers — applied at very low opacity so cards have edge definition without visual weight

mist.$description: Mist — Soft highlight washes, secondary text on light surfaces, and subtle icon fills

mid-gray.$description: Mid Gray — Muted body text, inactive labels, and disabled-state copy

steel.$description: Steel — Link text in resting state, secondary annotations, and icon strokes at low contrast

graphite.$description: Graphite — Tertiary headings, caption text, and supporting metadata

slate.$description: Slate — Lowest-emphasis body text, helper copy, and subdued annotations

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Icon strokes and outlines at medium contrast, secondary borders

electric-blue.$description: Electric Blue — Blue action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

inter.$description: Sole typeface across all UI, headings, and body. The complete weight range (400-700) allows a single family to carry the full hierarchy: 700 for display headlines, 600 for section headers, 500 for buttons and nav, 400 for body and captions. Inter's geometric neutrality and tall x-height make it ideal for a dark canvas where character width and spacing carry more visual weight than personality.
